entities.name: Query 102-aa nucleoside phosphorylase
observations: Sequence length is 102 aa; predicted molecular weight is 11,275 Da and theoretical pI is 5.07.
Contains a Ppnp Pfam domain (PF06865.18) spanning residues 11–101, with i-Evalue 4.6e-37.
Shows strong homology to reviewed pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases, including Sulfurovum sp. A6QCX3 at 71% identity and 98% query coverage.

Homolog annotations support reversible phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to free bases and alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate; exact substrate breadth is inferred from homologs rather than directly tested for this sequence.

entities.name: A6QCX3
observations: Reviewed UniProt homolog from Sulfurovum sp. NBC37-1; 71% identical to the query over 98% query coverage.
Annotated as pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase with EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: General reaction: nucleoside + inorganic phosphate ⇌ free nucleobase + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Reported homolog substrates include uridine, adenosine, guanosine, cytidine, thymidine, inosine, and xanthosine; the enzyme can also catalyze the reverse glycosyl-transfer reactions.
Representative Rhea mappings include RHEA:19805, RHEA:27642, RHEA:52540, RHEA:13233, and RHEA:27646.
